proof_summary: Assuming the claimed eventual recurrence, the shifted terms \(a_n+1\) satisfy the Fibonacci recurrence; evaluating the seeds and performing a modular Fibonacci computation modulo \(p=195318521017\) shows that \(p\) divides both \(a_{249580077007}\) and \(a_{249580077006}\). Thus their gcd \(g>1\), and with \(q=(a_{249580077007}+a_{249580077006})/g\ge2\), the defining recurrence and the claimed recurrence at the next index force \(g+q=1+gq\), equivalently \((g-1)(q-1)=0\), a contradiction.
